big-news.text: Økokrim, the economic crime police, has arrested more than 30 people in what could become the biggest fisheries crime case in Norwegian history.
A man in his 20s from Trondheim died during a military exercise in Stjørdal on Thursday evening.
One person died early this morning when a fire spread from an outdoor annex to a caravan in Kviteseid, Telemark.
A German indictment names two Norwegian citizens and describes them as Hamas operatives.

whats-changing.text: Ruter's 30-day pass gets cheaper this Sunday, Nov 1. An adult zone 1 pass drops by 160 kr to 495 kr. Other tickets and the annual pass stay at their old prices, so while this lasts (until about April 2027) it's cheaper to buy month by month.

be-aware.text: A Telenor survey found that one in four Norwegians has been scammed while shopping online, and many scams are now tailored to your own interests. Worth remembering with Black Friday coming.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: The Great Halloween Hunt is a free outdoor quiz trail around Lilleaker, running from today through Sunday.
Historisk museum celebrates Día de los Muertos with free music, dance and an altar on Sunday at 11:00.
Stovnertårnet is a free walkway that climbs 15 m above the ground to a viewpoint, and metro line 5 gets you there.
MUNCH has free drop-in drawing with artists on Sunday, 10:00 to 12:00 and 13:00 to 15:30.
Akershus Fortress has a theatrical Halloween ghost trail from today through Sunday. Check the price before you go.
Norsk Folkemuseum does Halloween on Saturday and Sunday from 11:00, with Day of the Dead during the day and spookier trails later. It's ticketed at 200 kr for adults, so it's not free.
